what: Two scenes overlap on one screen — the front scene’s large text melts away as a lump with blur 0→45 and alpha threshold ×40 −20, the small text smears out with blur 10 and ×10 −4 and floats up 50px, while the back scene’s text sharpens out of a blur 10 ×10 −4 blotch, rising from 50px below. When the section head passes 100px above the screen, a 1.2s power1.inOut timeline runs once (reversed when rewound), and the back scene’s opacity goes 0→1 in the last .6s. When the section tail reaches one screen before the bottom, the back scene turns off in .4s and exits 100px upward in .8s. With mode: scrub, it is tied to scroll for one screen starting from the section head (default 2s curve, blur 8·×50 −30 and 2·×8 −6 take 3s) and melts.

options.mode: play (spins once when passed, default) · scrub (tied to scroll)
options.at: in play, how many px the section head must pass above the screen before it spins, default 100
options.length: Scroll length to bind in scrub (multiple of screen height), default 1
options.melt-blur: Large text blur, default play 45 · scrub 8
options.soft-blur: Small text·forming text blur, default play 10 · scrub 2
options.melt-cut: Large text alpha threshold ‹multiplier  subtract›, default play ‹40  -20› · scrub ‹50  -30›
options.soft-cut: Small-text alpha threshold, default play ‹10  -4› · scrub ‹8  -6›
options.exit: With off, the next scene does not drop out at the tail
options.[data-fx-part=melt]: Large text or logo that melts as one mass from the previous scene
options.[data-fx-part=melt-soft]: Small text that bleeds out and fades from the previous scene
options.[data-fx-part=form]: Text that melts into place from the back scene
options.[data-fx-part=dim]: (if present) video · photo that darkens up to .4 as the previous scene leaves
